memory_candidates.content: When planning against a research report, re-verify the report's 'add this missing field' recommendations against the live source store before sizing the phase. In the events.jsonl/OTel seam design, the research report recommended adding a `cwd` field plus a `--cwd` flag plus hook capture plus query-time repo derivation; all four already existed on disk (events-schema.json property, events-append.sh flag, both event-writing hooks capturing from stdin, events-query.sh --repo/by_repo derivation). Only `cc_session_id` was genuinely new. The already-implemented feature then served as an exact per-call-site template for the new one, converting a multi-file design phase into a mechanical mirror of an existing code path. Research reports go stale against a moving source store; a grep for the recommended field name across every file the report names is a cheap plan-time gate that both prevents duplicate work and often surfaces a ready-made implementation template.
